AA0001.justification: Spacing around binary operators is pure layout the formatter fixes; no behaviour changes, so a gate from Strict only.

AA0002.justification: A stray space after a unary operator is pure layout the formatter fixes; a gate from Strict only.

AA0003.justification: Spacing after NOT is pure layout the formatter fixes; a gate from Strict only.

AA0005.justification: BEGIN..END around a single statement is clutter, not a defect; style gated from Strict.

AA0008.justification: Parentheses on parameterless calls tell a call from a field or variable at a glance; advisory, a gate from Strict.

AA0013.justification: Placement of BEGIN after THEN, ELSE or DO is pure layout the formatter fixes; a gate from Strict only.

AA0018.justification: Control keywords that do not start a line are layout only and the formatter fixes them; a gate from Strict only.

AA0021.justification: Ordering declarations by type is a house style with no effect on behaviour and many hits in old code; Info at Strict, gated in Complete.

AA0022.justification: Rewriting IF ELSE chains as CASE is a readability opinion; Info at Strict, gated in Complete.

AA0040.justification: Nested WITH makes it unclear which record a name binds to and can bind the wrong one; advisory, a gate from Strict.

AA0050.justification: Granting permissions on another app's objects from a permission set extension breaks when that app changes and widens access silently; Warning from Recommended.

AA0051.justification: Pulling another app's permission sets into an extension couples to permissions you do not own and widens access; Warning from Recommended.

AA0052.justification: Including sets that carry permissions on another app's objects widens access through a set you do not control; Warning from Recommended.

AA0053.justification: A wildcard in a permission set extension grants every object to everyone holding the base set; Warning from Essential as a security rule.

AA0072.justification: Opt-in naming rule that suffixes names with their type; an opinion many codebases reject, Info in Complete only.

AA0073.justification: A temporary record without the Temp prefix invites DeleteAll or Modify on what a reader thinks is real data; Warning from Recommended.

AA0074.justification: Approved label suffixes (Msg, Err, Qst, Tok, Lbl) show how a text is used; naming advice, a gate from Strict.

AA0087.justification: The lower-permissions test library declared outside a test codeunit drags test tooling into production code; Warning from Recommended.

AA0100.justification: Quoted identifiers make code harder to read and search; naming advice, a gate from Strict.
